name: Omarchy Slack
author: Casper Bottelet
description: Slack as a fast, themed Omarchy app: sign in with your browser, read and reply to DMs and channels, toggle presence and Do Not Disturb — with a mention badge in your bar. No Chromium, no half-gigabyte client.

barWidget.description: Slack icon that badges up with unread DMs; click to open the Slack app overlay

schema.label: Refresh every
schema.description: Minutes between unread-count polls for the bar badge.
